issues.description: The problem statement/UML specifies the Farm.animals attribute as private and instructs students to provide a getter and setter. In the provided solution, the animals field is declared public (public List<Animal> animals;), which contradicts the UML/privacy expectation and may confuse students about the intended encapsulation.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the animals field in Farm.java to be private (private List<Animal> animals;) to match the UML and instructions. Keep the public getter and setter for accessing/modifying the list. Ensure the template and solution consistently use private visibility for the attribute.
